fato_historico: 1865: Major Henry Wirz, the superintendent of a prison camp in Andersonville, Georgia, is hanged, becoming one of only three American Civil War soldiers executed for war crimes.
energia_do_dia: Today the universe encourages you to release heavy burdens from the past. Just as a new page turns in the grand book of history, you may find peace by letting go of old grievances. It is a good time to embrace forgiveness and allow your intuitive spirit to wash away lingering shadows with a wave of deep, restorative kindness.
frase_do_dia: True freedom is found when we choose to release what no longer serves our heart.
significado_numero: Represents spiritual insight and the bridge between two worlds.
conselho: Consider walking near water to clarify your thoughts and restore your natural inner balance.
